The following presentation is being made only to, and is only directed at, persons to whom such presentations may lawfully

This presentation does not constitute an offering of securities or otherwise constitute an invitation or inducement to any

non-GAAP financial information.
The Group’s management believes these measures provide valuable additional information in understanding the
performance of the Company’s businesses because they provide measures used by the company to assess performance.
Although these measures are important in the management of the business, they should not be viewed as replacements for,
but rather as complementary to, the comparable GAAP measures.
